title: Score-Aligned Choir Cleanup
user: Community choirs preserving archival recordings when they have the score but need a cautious, local way to make rehearsal copies easier to hear.
smallest_useful_product: Desktop app that imports audio plus a MusicXML/PDF section map, lets the user mark rehearsal passages, applies transparent local noise/EQ presets, and exports labeled excerpts with an edit receipt.
constraints: Keep recordings local; require rights confirmation before export; preserve originals and make every filter reversible; do not promise forensic restoration or individual-part isolation.
